target: AArch64 native ZealC in UTM-bundled QEMU with HVF, one vCPU, virtio-ramfb, VirtIO keyboard and tablet
command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-budget-current-utm-qemu.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-budget-program
checks: scanner/form reflection and malformed form recovery
File/Edit/View shortcuts and menu hover continue to render
scope_note: Automated run under UTM-bundled QEMU, not a visible UTM app-window test. It does not resolve the previously reported live UTM freeze or cover account-file editing and account-filter UI.
